articles.title: Crypto's campaign arm, Fairshake, sets lists of U.S. House favorites it'll spend on
articles.snippet: The super PAC shared a list of more than 30 incumbent candidates it's backing, with about a million dollars going to three names from each party.

articles.title: Kraken operator Payward and Singapore Gulf Bank partner for 24/7 institutional crypto settlement
articles.snippet: The two firms will initially roll out the digital assets settlement service to select institutional clients in Asia and the Gulf region with around-the-clock U.S. dollar settlement.

articles.title: There's an election next month: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Congress is gone from Washington for the final pre-election recess, and it's time to take stock of what's going on ahead of November.

articles.title: The Clarity Act stalled. Bankers aren’t hitting the brakes yet on crypto dealmaking
articles.snippet: Crypto M&A has hit record levels, but the Clarity Act’s Senate setback leaves dealmakers weighing how much regulatory uncertainty still matters.

articles.title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
articles.snippet: Fairshake said it would financially back 32 House candidates who all voted in favor of the CLARITY market structure bill in 2025, as the legislation remains in limbo in the Senate.
